title: Image AID via continuous-time reinforcement learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.13010v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study image inpainting with generative diffusion models. Existing methods typically either train dedicated task-specific models, or adapt a pretrained diffusion model separately for each masked image at deployment. We introduce a middle-ground model, termed Amortized Inpainting with Diffusion (AID), which keeps a pretrained diffusion backbone fixed, trains a small reusable guidance module offline, and then reuses it across masked images without per-instance optimization. We formulate it as a deterministic guidance problem with a supervised terminal objective. To make this problem learnable in high dimensions, we derive an auxiliary Gaussian formulation and prove that solving this randomized problem recovers the optimal deterministic guidance field. translated_title: 基于连续时间强化学习的图像AID（摊销扩散图像修复）
translated_abstract: 我们研究使用生成扩散模型进行图像修复。现有方法通常要么训练专门的任务特定模型，要么在部署时针对每个带掩码的图像分别对预训练扩散模型进行适配调整。我们提出了一种折中方案，称为摊销扩散修复，它保持预训练的扩散主干网络不变，离线训练一个小型可复用的引导模块，然后在不同带掩码图像之间复用该模块，而无需逐实例优化。我们将该问题形式化为一个带有监督终端目标的确定性引导问题。为了使该问题在高维空间中可学习，我们推导了一种辅助高斯形式，并证明求解该随机化问题可以恢复最优的确定性引导场。这一理论桥梁催生了一种有原则的连续时间演员-评论家算法，能够以完全数据驱动的方式学习引导模块。在实验上，在AFHQv2和FFHQ数据集上的p（原文摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AID方法，保持预训练扩散模型固定不变，通过连续时间演员-评论家算法离线训练一个小型可复用的引导模块，实现无需逐图像优化的高效摊销式图像修复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AID, which keeps a pretrained diffusion model fixed and trains a small reusable guidance module offline via a principled continuous-time actor-critic algorithm, enabling efficient amortized image inpainting without per-instance optimization.
